messages:
Alex M: quick heads-up — i'm switching out at 09:30 UTC, leaving the next two hours to @priya. i'd like to lock the primary/secondary so we don't overlap. i'm pasting the short checklist i ran and a couple of runbook links. :spiral_note_pad:

Priya S: thanks alex — i'll take primary from 09:30->11:30. @jamal can you be secondary until 11:00? otherwise i'll call for backup. :thumbsup:

Jamal R: can do until 11:00 UTC. i'll be available for paging if anything pops. also, note the DB replica lag flared briefly at ~03:40 UTC but resolved automatically. left metrics in case you want to check.

Marta L: no active incidents on my side. quick reminder — for customer-impacting errors follow the "customer-impact" runbook and start the bridge within 5m if >10% errors or >30min sustained latency regression. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/customer-impact

Alex M: checklist I ran before handoff:
```
- verify primary healthchecks: ok
- kvcache warm: ~85% hit rate
- current autoscale headroom: 4 GPUs
- deploy window clear: yes
```
latency runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-degradation

incident-bot: ALERT 6154321995 - High p99 latency on embeddings-service (region: us-east-1). metric: p99 = 2.7s, threshold = 2.0s. severity inferred: sev2. Link: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/6154321995 :rotating_light:

Priya S: ack alert — i'm looking. @jamal i'm paging you now as secondary. if we don't have mitigation in 7m escalate to @SRE Lead.

Jamal R: received pager, checking recent deploys and model variants. trying quick rollback of quant config on the embed fleet.

Alex M: if rollback fails, follow this temp mitigation sequence (short form):
1) route 25% of traffic to fallback model variant (variant-b)
2) increase batching token cap to reduce small-request overhead
3) clear prefix cache for hot customers only
Commands:```/runbook run fallback-variant variant-b --pct 25
/ops set batching.max_tokens=1024```

Marta L: paging/escalation matrix we agreed on — copy here for the handoff thread so it's clear: 
- Sev3 (minor, single-customer) -> page primary immediately, wait 10m, if still degraded page secondary, 30m review with SRE lead.
- Sev2 (regional/perf regression) -> page primary immediately, page secondary at 5m, page SRE Lead at 15m, start bridge at 10m if impact persists.
- Sev1 (customer outage, data loss) -> page primary + secondary + SRE Lead simultaneously, start bridge within 5m, exec-notify after 30m.

Priya S: re: paging commands — use `/page @<name> reason "<short reason>"` and include the alert ID. if you need to escalate to SRE Lead call out `@SRE Lead` in the first page and add `#bridge` to force bridge creation.

incident-bot: NOTE - Incident scoring suggests Sev2 -> if mitigation doesn't reduce p99 under 2.0s in 10 minutes, severity will auto-promote.

Jamal R: rollback applied, observing metrics... p99 dropped to 1.9s after ~2 minutes. continuing to watch for stabilization. will keep routing at 100% to primary for now.

Alex M: awesome — thanks. final few handoff notes: keep the handoff doc updated (https://redwood.internal/handoffs/daily) with any lingering mitigations, add short bullet for postmortem triggers: >15m customer-facing impact or >2 rollbacks. i'll be reachable on phone if needed. :phone:

SRE Lead: noted — if any regression recurs on the same cluster within 24h escalate directly to me and mark incident for follow-up. good handoff team.

Priya S: closing loop here — primary/secondary confirmed, page rules copied, runbooks linked, mitigation succeeded. i'll post a short incident recap if anything else changes. :white_check_mark:
